 Avengers: Secret Wars Is ‘A Whole Other Genre Of Story’ To Doomsday, Teases Kevin Feige
 © Getty by Ben Travis | Published on 16th November 2026 at 2.01pm People: Kevin Feige Anthony Russo Joe Russo Follow Empire on Google As the Avengers: Doomsday clock ticks down, there’s already plenty to look forward to. We have Robert Downey Jr.’s take on Doctor Doom . The return of Shang-Chi . Several factions of heroes all banding together. A comeback for the classic X-Men team. And that’s only the beginning – because Doomsday will be followed by another epic team-up not long after, 2027’s Avengers: Secret Wars . Just as directors Joe and Anthony Russo pulled off the double-whammy of Infinity War and Endgame a year apart, the plan is to do the same with Doomsday and Secret Wars – and like the last two Avengers movies, it seems the upcoming pair will be distinct in vibes.
 As Marvel boss Kevin Feige tells Empire , the upcoming Secret Wars “is a whole other genre of story” to Doomsday . Joe Russo agrees, promising “a really unique world” for the follow-up. “It’s a really unique story,” he teases. “The only reason to get out of bed every day is to take risks and surprise people and try things that have never been tried before. I think Secret Wars is one of those movies where I hope people will walk out of it and go, ‘I’ve never seen anything like that in my life!’”
 With two comic book runs of Secret Wars to look back – plus the fact that the MCU has always provided its own twists on the source material – fans can start speculating now on what elements might make it into Doomsday and Secret Wars , and where each story might stop or pick up from. Either way, it sounds like we’re in for a bold one-two punch of mega-blockbusters – place your predictions now, ahead of Secret Wars landing in cinemas in December 2027.
 Read Empire ’s full 22-page Avengers: Doomsday coverage – speaking to Kevin Feige, Joe and Anthony Russo, Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Ian McKellen, Florence Pugh, Anthony Mackie, Simu Liu, David Harbour, Vanessa Kirby, Sebastian Stan, Letitia Wright, Tom Hiddleston, Hannah John-Kamen, James Marsden, Rebecca Romijn, and Winston Duke – in the January 2027 issue, on sale Thursday November 19, with four covers to collect. Avengers: Doomsday comes to cinemas from December 18.
